method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 25 of 25 breaks heard

lines.english: Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy,
for we have sinned against Thee.
Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy,
for we have sinned against Thee.

lines.latin: Ad te Rex summe, ómnium Redémptor,
lines.english: To Thee, O King most high, Redeemer of all,
we lift up our eyes in weeping;
hear, O Christ, the prayers of Thy suppliants.

lines.latin: Atténde Dómine, et miserére, quia peccávimus tibi.
lines.english: Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy, for we have sinned against Thee.
Right hand of the Father, corner-stone,
way of salvation, gate of heaven,
wash away the stains of our sin.

lines.latin: Atténde Dómine, et miserére, quia peccávimus tibi.
lines.english: Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy, for we have sinned against Thee.
We beseech Thy majesty, O God;
with Thy holy ears hear our groaning;
graciously pardon our crimes.
Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy,
for we have sinned against Thee.
To Thee we confess the sins we have committed;
with contrite heart we lay bare what was hidden;
may Thy loving-kindness, O Redeemer, forgive.

lines.latin: Atténde Dómine, et miserére, quia peccávimus tibi.
lines.english: Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy, for we have sinned against Thee.
Seized though innocent, led away unresisting,
condemned by false witnesses for the wicked;
keep, O Christ, those whom Thou hast redeemed.
Hearken, O Lord, and have mercy,
for we have sinned against Thee.
